title: Android 3.3.0 and upwards, huge increase in battery drain
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
This is observed in all major releases after AAPS 3.2.0.4 including the latest 3.3.1.2 Build: 202df2cebf-2025.01.15

Battery drain was previously around 5% per day. 

This has jumped to around 20%. 

[AndroidAPS._2025-01-05_00-00-21_.1.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18726058/AndroidAPS._2025-01-05_00-00-21_.1.zip)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1d357d88-bb5c-4ebe-8c0c-a74516fdc5d3)

I've tried a fresh install rather than update, and clearing cache. 

Rebooting obviously doesn't work. I'm using the NSClientV3 but have also tried disabling uploading to eliminate this as a possible culprit. 

Setting are completely unchanged between 3.2.0.4 and 3.3.1.2, hardware is also completely unchanged. 

Re-installing 3.2.0.4 lowers the daily battery drain back down to 5%, but this will soon be an unsupported version so this isn't a permanent fix.
